name: Bauxite / aluminium
note: Guyana (Bosai, Linden), Suriname (historic Alcoa), Brazil (MRN, Hydro).
uses: Bauxite is refined to alumina and smelted to aluminium for transport, packaging, construction and electricity transmission.
why_it_matters: Guyana, Suriname and Brazil have long bauxite histories; China is the world's largest smelter, and the Guyanese and Surinamese industries have changed hands between Western and Chinese owners.
uses_source: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (annual; uses as summarised there) and the registry notes; curated text, no figures

hs_codes.description: Aluminium oxide (alumina), other than artificial corundum
